findings.text: the head-run gate logs record revision 961b288ee5201b2361b9aae155fa9227b0a603aa, the pre-commit HEAD, for runs that measured uncommitted content, and the head sha 9063058c appears in no log at all, so the artifact that should say what was measured does not identify the content measured — a reader taking the header at face value reads the base revision as having been tested.

the constructor's project parameter has no caller anywhere in the tree (no Ticker( call in reckon/ or tests/ passes project=), so the instance-project fallback at reckon/crew/ticker.py:940 is unreachable in production and the parameter reads as load-bearing while nothing reaches it.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 961b288e; a45e4387 touches only the three fenced source and test paths — the resolver's project argument, the per-row project read, the per-project width cache and grid-width helper, the two hues, and the column derivations the previous review named — and 9063058c adds only the plan's corrective paragraph and the cumulative evidence anchor.
item_verdicts.done_when: the measure is both fenced files green with 0 failures under a config declaring no alias and under one declaring dsv4.1-flash, the model-cell resolution passing the row's project with its docstring stating the layers, the action-set test green, and a logged negative control; the manifest records 94 passed in each config against 2 and 11 failures at base 961b288e, and my own re-run at 9063058c in the reviewed tree reproduces 94 passed in each config (rereview/gate-head-noalias.log, rereview/gate-head-alias.log), with the declared control reproduced here at 5 failed, 89 passed (rereview/controls.log).
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that both fenced ticker test files read the model width the rendered grid uses, that the ticker resolves the model aliases with the project layer a dispatch reads, and that launch-failed carries a light-theme hue; all three land — neither test file carries the MODEL constant any longer (grep -c returns 0 in each), reckon/crew/ticker.py:663 resolves through flight_module.resolve(project) with the row's own project read at reckon/crew/ticker.py:940, and STATE_HUE carries launch-failed in both themes at reckon/crew/ticker.py:117 and reckon/crew/ticker.py:138.
item_verdicts.manifest: read at the run directory; it records status complete, both config results with their logs, the declared control with its mutation spelled on the red log's first line, and the head sha under commits, while the gate logs themselves open with the pre-commit revision 961b288e rather than the content they measured.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared fence is reckon/crew/ticker.py, tests/test_crew_ticker.py, tests/test_crew_ticker_layout.py, docs/evidence/archive/a-monitor-row-reads-at-a-glance-landed.html, docs/figures/a-monitor-row-reads-at-a-glance and docs/plans/a-monitor-row-reads-at-a-glance.html; git diff --name-status 961b288e..9063058c lists five paths, all inside it, with no figure touched this round.

justifications.durability: the new test at tests/test_crew_ticker_layout.py:966 fails when the resolver drops the project (rereview/controls.log, alias elided to project-o…), the declared control reddens five tests there, and the derived expectations at tests/test_crew_ticker_layout.py:1204 and :952 are anchored by the literal at tests/test_crew_ticker_layout.py:952, though the floor at tests/test_crew_ticker_layout.py:1233 is now read from the grid under test and only pinned elsewhere at tests/test_crew_ticker_layout.py:470.
justifications.evidence: the gate is the measure the done_when states and its result is recorded, reproduced here at 94 passed under both configs (rereview/gate-head-alias.log), but the head logs at .../runs/r-20260923T172753966510-ticker-tests-read-the-grid-width/logs/gate-alias.log:1 name the pre-commit revision 961b288e and the two configs they used were /tmp files that no longer exist.
justifications.fit: the helpers at reckon/crew/ticker.py:860 and reckon/crew/ticker.py:875 sit in the module's own register and carry no plan or ticket identifier, and the docstring at reckon/crew/ticker.py:646 now matches the four layers reckon/flight.py:662 resolves.
justifications.goal_fidelity: all three clauses are live and reachable in production — the row's project is read at reckon/crew/ticker.py:940 from events the watcher builds with it at reckon/crew/recovery.py:4596, and dropping the project from the resolution at reckon/crew/ticker.py:663 elides the project's own alias in my control (rereview/controls.log).
justifications.scope_discipline: every one of the five paths in git diff --name-status 961b288e..9063058c lies inside the declared fence, with the project parameter at reckon/crew/ticker.py:829 the one surface no caller in the tree reaches.
